folder.permission: you don't have permission to change it
folder.notFolderNow: it isn't a folder any more
folder.busy: wait for the run in {{name}} to finish, or stop it, before starting another
folder.runGone: that run isn't there any more
folder.driveRoot: this is the root of a drive, not a folder FolderSkin can skin
folder.home: this is your home folder. Pick a folder inside it instead
folder.system: that folder belongs to the operating system or an app. Pick one of your own folders
folder.macosRefused: macOS refused to change this folder's icon (is it writable?)
folder.unsupported: custom folder icons are not supported on this OS
folder.pathGone: that path doesn't exist any more

os.full: No space left on device (os error {{code}})
os.notFound: No such file or directory (os error {{code}})

picture.heicUnsupported: HEIC pictures aren't supported here yet. Export it as PNG or JPEG first
picture.noDataFolder: skins are only kept until you quit, since there is no data folder
picture.notAPicture: that file isn't a picture FolderSkin can read (try a PNG, JPEG or WebP)
picture.tooBigRef: that picture is too big to use as a reference (over 64 MB)

community.notListed: that pack isn't listed any more. Try Refresh
community.badFolderName: that folder's name has no letters or digits to use
community.noPackJson: that folder has no pack.json. See docs/PACKS.md
community.missingFile: {{file}} is missing. File names have to match exactly, capitals included
community.tooManySkins: that's {{count}} skins, and a pack holds at most {{max}}
community.skinGone: one of those skins isn't saved any more
community.notYours: {{name}} came from someone else's pack, so it can't go in yours
community.tooBig: the pictures come to {{size}} MB, and a pack's come to {{max}} MB at most. Split them into two packs
community.folderExists: there's already a folder called {{id}} there
community.unreachable: couldn't reach {{host}}. Check your connection and try again
community.gone: it isn't on {{host}} any more. Try Refresh
community.answered: {{host}} answered {{status}}. Try again in a minute
community.notYet: the newest list of packs isn't there yet. Try again in a minute
community.catalogDamaged: the catalog of community packs arrived damaged. Try again
community.notPublished: the community packs aren't published yet
community.listDamaged: that pack's list arrived damaged. Try again
community.listMismatch: that pack's list doesn't match the catalog. Try Refresh

chats.noDataFolder: chats can't be kept on this computer: FolderSkin has no data folder here
chats.tooMany: this chat has more than {{max}} requests. Start a new one
chats.tooBig: this chat has grown too big to keep. Start a new one
chats.gone: that chat isn't on this computer any more
chats.damaged: that chat's file is damaged and can't be opened

composer.damaged: that design is damaged, so it can't be opened again

icons.noDataFolder: FolderSkin has no data folder to keep icon packs in
icons.download: couldn't download the icon pack. Check your connection and try again
icons.notPublished: that icon pack isn't published yet. Try again after the next update
icons.server: the icon pack's server answered {{status}}. Try again later

share.noService: This build of FolderSkin can't share packs. You can still save the pack as a folder.
share.unreachable: FolderSkin's sharing service can't be reached right now. Check your connection and try again.
share.verifyFirst: Verify this computer first, so the service knows the pack is yours.
share.banned: This computer can't share packs any more, because a pack from it broke the pack terms.
share.paused: Sharing is paused for now. Please try again later.
share.badName: A name is 3 to 39 letters, digits and single dashes, not starting or ending with a dash.
share.timeout: The check in your browser wasn't finished in time. Start again when you're ready.
share.noKey: This computer has no sharing key yet.
share.keyNotSaved: The recovery file couldn't be saved: {{reason}}
share.serviceUnreachable: FolderSkin's sharing service couldn't be reached. Check your connection and try again.
share.serviceUnreadable: FolderSkin's sharing service answered in a way this version can't read. Update FolderSkin and try again.

ai.unauthorized: That key was rejected by {{provider}}. Check it was copied whole and is still active.
ai.rateLimited: {{provider}} is rate limiting you right now. Wait a moment and try again.
ai.timeout: {{provider}} took too long to finish the image. Try again, or pick a faster model.
ai.noBackdrop: The model drew a scene instead of a folder on a plain backdrop. Try again, or switch to Just the art, which does not need one.
ai.noImage: {{provider}} finished without painting a picture. Try again, or reword the idea.
ai.saidNothing: {{provider}} answered with error {{status}} and gave no reason
ai.unreadable: {{provider}} replied with something FolderSkin could not read: {{detail}}
ai.noPictureWhere: {{provider}} replied without a picture where FolderSkin looks for one: {{detail}}
ai.badImage: {{provider}} returned an image FolderSkin could not read
ai.lostTrack: {{provider}} lost track of the image before it was ready
ai.keyElsewhere: {{provider}} said to collect the picture somewhere FolderSkin doesn't send your key
ai.localNotReady: Skins can't be generated with the local model until it's set up.
ai.outOfMemory: The graphics card ran out of memory while painting.
ai.settingUp: The local model is being set up.
ai.painting: The local model is painting a picture.
ai.alreadySettingUp: The local model is already being set up.
ai.stoppedKept: Stopped. What was downloaded is kept, and setting up again carries on from there.
ai.notReadyAfter: Everything downloaded, but it still isn't ready to paint.
ai.unexpectedStop: Setting the local model up stopped unexpectedly.

fix.network: Check the internet connection (and any proxy or firewall), then try again.
fix.otherModel: Choose another model in the provider settings.
fix.later: Try again in a little while. If it keeps happening, try another model or another provider than {{provider}}.
fix.closeApps: Close apps that use the graphics card, such as games or video editors, then try again.
fix.restart: If it keeps happening, restart the computer: something may still be holding the graphics card's memory.
fix.details: If it keeps happening, open Details to see what the runtime said.
fix.useProvider: Or make pictures with a provider and your own key instead.
fix.setUpAgain: Set the local model up again in the provider settings.
fix.newSeed: Try again: each picture starts from a new seed.
fix.keptDownload: Try again. What was downloaded is kept.
fix.stopSetup: Stop the setup, then remove the model.
fix.waitPainting: Wait for it to finish, or stop it, then remove the model.
fix.waitSetup: Wait for it to finish, then try again.
fix.refFormat: Use a PNG, JPEG or WebP picture.
fix.stillProvider: You can still make pictures with a provider and your own key.
fix.report: If it happens again, please report it at {{url}} with what you were doing.

stage.cut: Cutting it out of the background
stage.waiting: Waiting for the picture before it to finish
stage.slow: Painting slowly: too little memory is free to hold the model, so it's read from the disk

local.noGpu: No graphics card it can use was found, so pictures are painted on the processor: expect a few minutes each.
local.lowMemory: With {{memory}} GB of memory this Mac paints slowly, and other apps slow down while it does: the model needs about 8 GB. A provider with your own key is quicker.
